installCommand: npm install --global pnpm@11.28.9 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter "@moon-cleanup/client..." --filter moon-cleanup
buildCommand: VITE_BUILD_VERSION=$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@moon-cleanup/client
ignoreCommand: git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- apps/client packages pnpm-lock.yaml package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json vercel.json tsconfig.base.json .nvmrc

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' https://*.onrender.com wss://*.onrender.com https://*.ingest.sentry.io https://*.ingest.us.sentry.io https://*.ingest.de.sentry.io; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob:; manifest-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'; form-action 'none'
gamepad=(self), fullscreen=(self), camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()
